local_duplicate_review_notes: Selected-source fingerprint 47c7e3735ccc28abd1e931b1206ac313b1ee8b2b8ceabdedd0c9890e02f74d66 remains distinct from previously accepted geometries; original source part and visible slab details distinguish this candidate. 005 is held as a variant of 003.
local_asset_shape_review_notes: Original 002 slab composed with the same-pack frame Metal_Doorframe_002, under explicit user approval. Aperture spans are adapted to the slab while keeping jamb/header profiles and frame depth; the assembly is reconstructed.
local_mechanical_review_notes: Attempt 000005: reviewed surface-mounted closed-unlatched assembly passes static and one RTX 4090 run to 91.1 degrees. All frame/slab/handle collisions and physics tolerances are retained; the 2% moving-fit bound is unchanged. Robot/expert qualification remains pending.
local_visual_review_notes: Viewed front/rear RTX images in attempt 000005: original metal atlas, complete slab/frame and modeled hardware are retained. Surface mounting and the inferred back-face pivot are explicit simulation assumptions.
